$comment: VAPP-234 (spec apps.md §1.8, §17 P2, C28) THE TEMPLATE GALLERY ×4: start an app from a SIGNED template. THE FILES = `dir`/<id>`fileSuffix` in the repo, each a full app file (app-export.json: `{format, app, package, records}`) signed with the package format's signature (`author` + `signature`, Ed25519 over the canonical JSON, exponential-ui `verifyPackageFile`) by `signer` (its `key` is PINNED: a template whose signature does not verify against exactly this key is refused, server-side, before anything is written). `records` = the template's SAMPLE records (no ids, no authors). `templates` = the gallery IN ORDER: `id` (= the file name), `name`, `icon` (the board icon set), `color`, `description` (one line); each entry equals its file's `app` block except `description` (the file keeps the package's long one) (gated). SIGNING: `bun packages/domain-contract/scripts/sign-app-templates.ts` re-signs every file in place with the seed in `EXP_APP_TEMPLATES_SEED` (32 bytes, unpadded base64url; never in the repo) and refuses a seed whose public key is not `signer.key`; `--check` verifies them (a test runs it). WHERE (existing components only, NO new UI): the IMPORT dialog/sheet (app-export.json, the Apps list band's `Import…` pill) opens with a TEMPLATES step above the paste field: the small muted section label `copy.title`, ONE grouped list (GlassGroup) of ListRows, one per template = BoardGlyph (icon + colour) + name (medium) over the muted one-line `description` (truncated), testId `testIds.row`-<id>; under it a grouped Switch row `copy.includeRecords` (off by default, testId `testIds.records`); then the import step exactly as before. A DRAFT's editor (apps.json NEW APP: every New app entry lands there) adds ONE more `mode: action` Pill `copy.fromTemplate` after the starters in its empty-chat EmptyState (testId `testIds.fromTemplate`; NOT disabled without a device: an import needs none), opening that same dialog/sheet. PICKING a row = tRPC `apps.importTemplate {teamId, template: <id>, includeRecords}` at once (every row disabled while it runs): the server reads the file, verifies the pinned signature, takes `templateImportFile(file, includeRecords)` (the pure reference, `importCases`: drops `author` + `signature`, drops `records` unless `includeRecords`) and imports it EXACTLY like `apps.import` (app-export.json: identity from the file, the slug derived from the name and de-duplicated, the package as v1 PUBLISHED at once noted `copy.note`, the sample records as the importer's), then the client opens the new app's editor (the empty draft left behind is discarded by apps.json CLEANUP). Any member. A failure = the failed-action toast (feedback-states.json). An unknown template id = BAD_REQUEST. CAPTURE (the `app-import` view ×5): the dialog/sheet shows the templates step over the import step.
